doc: docs/CONTROLLED_UNIT.md, The squadron slot in the selection tests
substitutions: The fused squadron slot's own four liveness bytes are the wing-0 plane's; the image's squadron entity outlives that plane.
The HUD observer releases the controlled unit at the slot's (wing-0 plane's) death; the image releases when the squadron entity goes (007F3A60).
The plane interface's camera hand-off (+6Ch/+68h) is not modelled; the mission camera stays unbound after a plane is selected.
